summary: This note is a wiki-style description of Steve Smith, a fictional character in the animated series American Dad! voiced by Scott Grimes. Steve is the son of Stan and Francine Smith, the younger brother of Hayley, and the youngest of the show's six main characters. The note highlights his status as a freshman at Pearl Bailey High School and his talent as an amateur musician who plays cello, guitar and sings.
one_line: Steve Smith is the youngest main character in the animated series American Dad!, a high school freshman and amateur musician voiced by Scott Grimes.
key_facts: Steven Anita "Steve" Smith is a fictional character in the animated television series American Dad!.
Steve Smith is voiced by Scott Grimes.
Steve Smith is the only son of Stan Smith and Francine Smith.
Steve Smith is the younger brother of Hayley Smith.
Steve Smith is the youngest of the six main characters of American Dad!.
Steve Smith is a freshman at Pearl Bailey High School.
Steve Smith took up the cello to impress a girl.
In a later episode, Steve Smith says that he has been playing the cello since he was nine.
Steve Smith plays guitar and sings.
Steve Smith was part of a band in the episode "American Dream Factory."
The two songs Steve's band rehearses in "American Dream Factory" are "Livin' on the Run" and "Sunset Blvd."
Both songs rehearsed by Steve's band were originally recorded by Scott Grimes, who voices Steve.
